name: Dragonborn

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.description: You perceive Dim Light as Bright Light, without a separate range limit. This does not permit you to see through Darkness.
You have 50 percent resistance to the damage type associated with your specific dragon ancestry.

On your turn when you take the Attack action, you can replace one of the attacks with your Breath Weapon. Targets in the area defined by your dragon ancestry make a Dexterity saving throw against DC 8 + your Proficiency Bonus + your Constitution modifier. A failed save deals damage of your dragon ancestry's type; a successful save takes half damage. Uses equal Proficiency Bonus and all expended uses return after a Long Rest.

reviewNotes: Low-Light Vision replaces baseline 60-foot Darkvision for all Dragonborn families and currently playable ancestries; 30-foot walking speed remains subject to comparative Species balance. Specialized future ancestries may define their own vision and related light sensitivity.
5.5e temporary Draconic Flight is not automatically granted by the Dragonborn base Species.
Languages and learned draconic traditions are deferred to independently selectable Upbringings. Ability-score adjustments remain deferred.
